summary: Standards/evidence: tier.durability-release.01 has no evidence record at all. The ledger holds evidence for tier.durability-release.02 (and the 0.39 tier.durability.01-16) at d4f00082a, but `grep '"tier.durability-release.01"' .canon/ledger/kind=evidence` finds nothing, and the CHANGELOG still cites `tier.durability-release.01-02`. The tests that prove its Then (tier_durability_01 in atomic.rs and tier_durability_03 in artifact_store.rs, both #[cfg(all(unix, debug_assertions))] since 0.39) are bound only to tier.durability.01/03. I re-ran them in debug at 7fd0e5f0f and they pass (canon-store+canon-gate 501/501), so the behavior holds, but there is nothing for a review to pin, so I did not sign it. Fix: `canon evidence add --scenario tier.durability-release.01` with --case naming those two tests (a junit report from a debug nextest run). Blast radius: none in code; only this scenario's coverage and the change's ship guard.
